task:
Create a snapshot backup of the etcd database.

Requirements:
  - Save the backup to: /var/backup/etcd-snapshot.db
  - Create the directory if it doesn't exist
  - Use the etcd certificates from /etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/

Then verify the snapshot is valid.

The etcd endpoint is typically https://127.0.0.1:2379 on kubeadm clusters.
Certificate paths:
  --cacert  /etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/ca.crt
  --cert    /etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/server.crt
  --key     /etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/server.key
hints: Install etcdctl if not present: apt install etcd-client
detailed_hints: Then verify: ETCDCTL_API=3 etcdctl snapshot status /var/backup/etcd-snapshot.db --write-out=table

validators.description: etcd pod is running in kube-system
validators.command: kubectl get pods -n kube-system -l component=etcd -o jsonpath='{.items[0].status.phase}'
